arguments.value: 69-year-old African American woman with depression and opioid use disorder on methadone maintenance was brought to the emergency department for worsening paranoia and suspiciousness over 1 week, with insomnia and collateral-reported confusion/agitation after stopping/missing methadone. Medical workup was unrevealing, and she improved after restarting methadone and starting aripiprazole, with resolution of psychotic symptoms.
